[size=4][color=yellow][b][size=5]Precautions for updating from 1.02 ver to 1.1.1 ver.[/size]
[size=3]Delete all existing files and download new files. Otherwise, a mode collision may occur.[/size]


"Kimchi"[/b][/color] is not "Pao Chai (Chinese food)", nor is it "Kimuchi (Japanese food)".[/size]
[b][size=6][color=yellow]"Kimchi"[/color] is a traditional Korean food.[/size][/b] [size=6]Please do not distort the facts.
[/size][size=4]The oldest record of kimchi in Korean history is "東國李相國集", which was a book written in the [color=#ffff00][b]13th century[/b][/color].
The tradition of making and sharing Kimchi is listed as [b]an Intangible Cultural Heritage of Republic of Korea by Unesco in 2013[/b].
Kimchi has been registered as an international standard with the International Food Standards Commission (CODEX) under the United Nations Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) in 2001.[/size]
[size=4][b]
Contact me only when there is an error in running the game.
I won't answer the other kind of bug reports.
[/b][/size]
